# Lifespan timeline of British royal consorts

This is a graphical lifespan timeline of British royal consorts. Eleven people reigned as British royal consorts since the political union of the Kingdom of England and the Kingdom of Scotland on 1 May 1707. They are listed in order of reign.
ImageSize = width:$width height:$height
PlotArea  = right:10 left:1 bottom:80 top:60
Period    = from:$start till:$end
TimeAxis  = orientation:horizontal
Legend    = orientation:vertical position:bottom columns:1

id:bg              value:white
id:lightline       value:rgb(0.8, 0.8, 0.8)
id:lighttext       value:rgb(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
id:LIFESPAN        value:rgb(0.88, 0.90, 0.70) Legend: Lifespan
id:s      value:orange Legend: Stuart
id:h      value:blue Legend: Hanover
id:sx     value:red Legend: Saxe-Coburg_and_Gotha
id:w      value:green Legend: Windsor
id:NAME            value:rgb(0.15, 0.13, 0.05)
id:TODAY           value:green
